name: insert
description:
The phrase with text added at its start and at its end.

The text goes as given; an empty phrase gets it too.

before: the text at the start («купить » gives «купить диван»).
after: the text at the end («диван» with « в москве» gives «диван в москве»).
each_word: round each word of the phrase instead («купить диван» with after "," → «купить, диван,»); the words are joined by one space and an empty phrase stays empty.

Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" insert --after " в москве" write -
-> купить диван в москве
Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" insert --after "," --each-word write -
-> купить, диван,

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --before
options.description: the text at the start («купить » gives «купить диван»).

options.name: --after
options.description: the text at the end («диван» with « в москве» gives «диван в москве»).

options.name: --each-word
options.description: round each word of the phrase instead («купить диван» with after "," → «купить, диван,»); the words are joined by one space and an empty phrase stays empty.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
